Package de.labathome.trustconstr

Class LinearVectorFunction

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.LinearVectorFunction
All Implemented Interfaces:
VectorFunctionLike
Direct Known Subclasses:
IdentityVectorFunction
public class LinearVectorFunction extends Object implements VectorFunctionLike
Linear vector function f(x) = A x and its derivatives.

Counterpart to scipy's LinearVectorFunction (scipy/optimize/_differentiable_functions.py:769). The Jacobian is the constant matrix A; the Hessian-of-Lagrangian is identically zero (returned as an n x n sparse zero matrix).

Caches the most recently evaluated point and f so repeated fun(Matrix) calls at the same x cost a single matvec.
